verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents screening against an Adverse Media database and a case-management workflow where analysts review the resulting alerts and risks, in the Mesh web app or via the API, and record decisions. The evidence never shows adverse-media matches being presented with linked source evidence (such as articles or URLs) or classified into risk categories, which is the core of this story. missing for 10: documentation of linked source evidence on adverse-media hits, documentation of an adverse-media risk-category taxonomy, hands-on or independent corroboration of the review experience.
